ice.text: Leshrac is the Walker of Night to whom Lim-Dul swears himself, body and soul, asking for power in return.
Leshrac and Mairsil manipulate Lim-Dul after the ring grants him great power, and Leshrac mutates him, giving him horns, after discovering his plan.

Trapped in the Shard during the Ice Age, Leshrac summons an elder dragon and plans with Tevesh Szat to conquer Shandalar, then escapes there and starts the War for Shandalar but is defeated by Kenan Sahrmal without his undead host.
In the last battle against Lim-Dul, Leshrac cuts off the necromancer's hand and planeswalks away with him.

tsp.text: Leshrac returns to Urborg and frees the Weaver King, and he is offered a powerful artifact by the Myojin of Night's Reach and accepts the bargain to fight Bolas.
He takes over Jeska's mind, using her and Radha to close the rifts in Yavimaya and Zhalfir, hoping to use her Phage powers against Nicol Bolas.
At the Madaran rift he strips Jeska of Phage's powers and attacks Bolas, paralyzing him and rotting his body, and the two fight from world to world.
Bolas, who had already defeated Night's Reach, impales Leshrac and traps him in the true mask, then uses it to close the Madaran rift, ending him.

fut.text: In Future Sight, Leshrac returns as Jeska comes back to Dominaria seeking vengeance for Karn.
Centuries later the Sisters order Leshrac to leave their plane.
